full_bc_pool_rule: a root's pool counts for the exact B/C joint loss only if every active slot of every pool sequence is decided; a partly masked pool trains single-outcome terms only
learner_allowlist: data.learner_tensors_v2 fields (scene, robot q/g/attachment, profile, FK, masks, anchor)

record_fields.J_first_label_mask: first complete relocation witness exists (independent of target result); empty repair J=0
record_fields.failure_provenance: stop status, normalized reason (addendum A2), budget
record_fields.outcome_active_mask: deterministic layout (z0, zS[catalogue], zR m>=1, zO[t] m>=2)
record_fields.outcome_decided_mask: active slot whose unit is POSITIVE or NEGATIVE
record_fields.root_id: split metadata only (never a learner input)
